_doc: In-run relics (lost when the run ends). rarity: common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary (scripts/progression/rarity.gd). stats: Player property or run stat -> amount added once on pickup. heal: HP restored on pickup. A relic is found at most once per run. tags: synergy tags this relic supports (relic drops favour tags you own). ability_mods: {Abilities mod key: amount} added to Abilities.mods. on_hit / on_kill: Abilities effect dictionaries appended to Abilities.global_on_hit / global_on_kill (see docs/team/abilities.md). codex_milestones: rewards paid once when that percentage of all relics has been discovered ({currency, amount} banked at once, {stat, amount} = permanent run bonus).
